Apple has continued to expand its car key feature support across the automotive industry, and the feature now appears to be coming to select models from a major Chinese automaker. Details below.

Apple Wallet Car Key Reportedly Coming to Great Wall Motors' Tank Models

According to findings by MacRumors, new backend code indicates that Apple may soon extend the Apple Wallet car key feature to models under Great Wall Motors' Tank brand.

Great Wall Motors currently has several models that support Apple CarPlay, including the Tank 300, Tank 400, Tank 500 and Tank 700, while models from its Haval, Ora, Wey and Poer brands are also on the supported list.

However, none of these models currently support the car key feature, which allows users to lock, unlock and start compatible vehicles using an iPhone or Apple Watch.

This news comes just days after new backend code indicated that the car key feature would also be coming to Volkswagen models. Apple has been steadily expanding the feature following recent rollouts by Toyota and Rivian.

Apple announced in 2025 that 13 additional car brands would adopt the car key feature, including Great Wall Motors' Wey brand, as well as Acura, Cadillac, Chery, Chevrolet, GMC, Hongqi, Lucid, Porsche, Rivian, Smart, Tata Motors and Voyah.

According to Apple's official website, there are currently over 800 CarPlay-compatible models, of which 52 also support the car key feature. For the full compatibility list, please follow this link.
